review.notes: All 28 bilingual entries read in full against native SlayMonsterQuest composition; five corrected entries reread. Parent fragments take accusative after Θυμάμαι; pants are idiomatic Greek singular with all three adjectives aligned. Colour label after σε χρώμα accepts all sixteen reviewed native colour fragments, including ουράνιο τόξο. All monster-count variants, elemental distinction and rewards preserved. Ντάγκι/Γλίτσα follow glossary; Frost Jelly consistently Ζελέ του Παγετού for later monster-name assets.
